title: String Similarity
description: For two strings A and B, we define the similarity of the strings to be the length of the longest prefix common to both strings. Calculate the sum of similarities of a string S with each of it's suffixes.
input_format:
The first line contains the number of test cases *t*.
Each of the next *t* lines contains a string to process, s.
output_format: Output *t* lines, each containing the answer for the corresponding test case.
constraints: s is composed of characters in the range ascii[a-z]
